description: List the arrangements of one song — sequence, BPM, keys, lyrics and chord chart (optionally transposed). Elvanto: songs/arrangements/getAll.

chord_chart_key.description: Transpose the chord chart into this key, e.g. F#.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

name: elvanto_list_song_arrangements
title: List a song's arrangements
